author: codex-ai-root
prior_exposure: Root knew the independent reviewer proposed PRQ18, PBR3 and STC0, and the reported uncertainty categories. Root had not read candidate box coordinates, model scores/counts or proposed scope geometry for this calibration cohort before these raw views. This is not an independent blind count replication.
findings: PBR/STC October2 and PRQOctober5 are broadly cloud/haze obscured; no complete annotation area can be asserted from those cloudy views.

PRQOctober10 resolves numerous isolated elongated hulls in water and one white vessel inside the harbor. Several hulls lie outside the pre-existing anchorage boundary; membership must be checked without shifting the AOI. Small isolated point near the channel remains unknown.

PBR October9 has three continuous berth-aligned hull-like signatures under haze: western reddish hull with white end, northern hull with bright western superstructure, and southern hull with bright multicolor superstructure. The January18 raw context separates these from the pier geometry. Their precise boxes require scope comparison; automated cloud masks must remain intact.
STC October9 muelles/patios are cloud obscured. Tiny northern-water point with possible wake remains unresolved at this resolution; exclude rather than infer absence.
No model metric or threshold was consulted. Fixed training hyperparameters and target test remain unchanged.
